annotations.text: DRIFTING LEDGER — the direction built out. Three layers on the paper: ruled lines creeping upward, three soft ink blooms drifting on 30-38s cycles, and a grain sheet shifting on its own axis. Cards deal in with a tilt and turn on a loop with a sheen. Everything loops live here, so let it run.
The three card effects isolated and looping: deal-in, turn with sheen, and the hover state. Motion sits on the card chrome and the ground, never behind answer text.
Two louder grounds beside the deliverable, each with its honest tradeoff. Both are more visible than the lead — which is the point of showing them rather than describing them.
